# MSR Foods

> Premium Honey Nut Mix — Pure Taste. Natural Goodness.
> Pakistan's finest artisanal honey nut mix, crafted from raw mountain honey and premium dry fruits. Pakistan-wide delivery via COD.

## About

MSR Foods is a Pakistani e-commerce brand founded in 2026, based in Kohat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. We specialise in handcrafted Honey Nut Mix — a premium superfood blend of raw mountain honey, California almonds, Kashmiri walnuts, cashews, Iranian pistachios, peanuts, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, and sesame seeds.

- Website: https://msrfoodsofficial.food
- Founded: 2026
- Location: Kohat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
- Delivery: Pakistan-wide (3–5 working days)
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (COD)
- Currency: PKR (Pakistani Rupee)

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Q: Do you deliver across Pakistan?
  A: Yes. We deliver Pakistan-wide via TCS, Leopard Courier, Trax Logistics, and PostEx within 3–5 working days.

- Q: What payment methods do you accept?
  A: We currently accept Cash on Delivery (COD) only.

- Q: Is there free shipping?
  A: Yes, free shipping on all orders above PKR 5,000.

- Q: What sizes are available?
  A: We offer three sizes — 250g Starter Jar (PKR 899), 500g (PKR 1,599), and 1kg Family Pack (PKR 2,999).

- Q: Are the products natural?
  A: Yes. All our products use raw mountain honey and premium dry fruits with no artificial additives or preservatives.

- Q: How do I place an order?
  A: Visit https://msrfoodsofficial.food, select your product and size, and complete checkout with Cash on Delivery.

- Q: Can I track my order?
  A: Yes. After dispatch you will receive a tracking number via WhatsApp or SMS.

- Q: What is the shelf life?
  A: 12 months from date of manufacture when stored in a cool, dry place.
